column1: # Files of TUR's components that go into the image beside the programs of
# image/programs.tsv (image/README.md, "Programs built into the image"): data
# the programs read where they look for it by default, and the units that
# start them. One line each, two fields separated by a tab:
#   a file of the repository, or a shell pattern for several
#   the directory it is installed in, under the same name
# image/programs.sh reads this file in the build stage; a line that matches
# no file stops the build. The component's directory must be in
# Containerfile.containerignore and copied into the stage.
